segments.name: Static · locked frame
segments.action: Wait on the mark with shoulders loose. Let the eyes settle on the doorway.
segments.audio_intent: Natural room sound and one unforced breath.

shot_card.attention: Keep the whole body in the place.

beats.action: Keep your weight evenly placed; hear the footsteps fade.
beats.eyeline: Past the camera toward the doorway.

beats.action: Lift your gaze slightly, without moving your feet.
beats.eyeline: The doorway, then the shelf beyond.
beats.motivation: A new detail has caught your attention.

shot_card.continuity: Keep the stated eyeline through the cut.
shot_card.ending: Let the eyes settle on the doorway.
shot_card.opening: Wait on the mark with shoulders loose.
shot_card.practical_setup: Find a level paved opening with a wall or doorway behind the performer. Keep three metres clear in front for the camera and a clear exit at frame right.
shot_card.actor_instruction: Keep the head, hands and feet inside the frame.

visual_style.lighting: Soft side daylight outside; warm practical light by the shelf; keep the object highlight on the same side.
visual_style.palette: Muted stone and sage outside; warm wood in the room; one teal object gives the eye a destination.
visual_style.sound: Let footsteps introduce the film. The room becomes quiet at recognition. Finish on a deliberate breath and the table touch.
visual_style.visual_rules: Begin with visible space around the visitor. Narrow attention only after the discovery; return to a readable body gesture at the finish.
visual_style.wardrobe: Visitor keeps a plain rust overshirt. Maker keeps a dark top. Keep the object in the same position through its inserts.
